odc_type: infinite loop due to lack of convergence detection
observation_summary: The solver throws a TooManyEvaluationsException instead of a ConvergenceException when it becomes stuck in an infinite loop.
reasoning_summary: The Regula Falsi algorithm, when implemented with finite floating-point precision, can encounter scenarios where the update formula fails to produce a new value (i.e., the new approximation equals the existing bound). In the original code, this resulted in an infinite loop where the same point was evaluated repeatedly until the maximum evaluation count was reached, causing a TooManyEvaluationsException. The fix introduces an explicit check to detect when the algorithm is stuck (x == x1) and throws a ConvergenceException, which is the expected behavior for a solver that cannot progress further.
